import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

from collections import defaultdict
def solve(I):
    I=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in I]
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    O=[row[:] for row in I]
    for r in range(H):
        nz=[(c,I[r][c]) for c in range(W) if I[r][c]!=0]
        if not any(v==0 for _,v in nz):
            # full row: keep as-is? check demos: row0 demo2 unchanged -> yes keep
            continue
        best=None
        for L in range(2,W+1):
            cnt=defaultdict(set)
            valid=True
            for c,v in nz:
                cnt[c%L].add(v)
                if len(cnt[c%L])>1: valid=False;break
            if not valid: continue
            m={k:int(list(s)[0]) for k,s in cnt.items()}
            nb=sum(1 for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==0 and c%L in m)
            nundef=sum(1 for c in range(W) if I[r][c]==0 and c%L not in m)
            score=(nb,-nundef,-L)
            if best is None or score>best: best=score;m_=m
            O[r]=[m_.get(c%L) if I[r][c]==0 else I[r][c] for c in range(W)]
    return O

for name in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    Oi=solve(G[name+' input']); Os=G[name+' output']
    print(name, Oi==Os)
print(json.dumps(solve(G['Test input'])))
